isolation: the greeter service is stateless with no persisted data; each scenario asserts only on the response to its own request, so no shared state can leak between scenarios

scenarios.rule: Calling GET /hello with a name returns a greeting personalized to that name
scenarios.scenario: A named caller gets a personalized greeting

steps.text: an API Consumer calls GET /hello with name "Ada"
the response is a JSON greeting with message "Hello, Ada!"
steps.command: curl -s "$BASE/hello?name=Ada" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); exit(0 if d.get('message')=='Hello, Ada!' else 1)"

scenarios.rule: Calling GET /hello without a name still succeeds with a default greeting
scenarios.scenario: Omitting the name parameter still returns a greeting

steps.text: an API Consumer calls GET /hello without a name parameter
the response is a JSON greeting with message "Hello, World!"
steps.command: curl -s "$BASE/hello" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); exit(0 if d.get('message')=='Hello, World!' else 1)"

scenarios.rule: Calling GET /hello without a name still succeeds with a default greeting
scenarios.scenario: An empty name parameter still returns a greeting

steps.text: an API Consumer calls GET /hello with name ""
the response is a JSON greeting with message "Hello, World!"
steps.command: curl -s "$BASE/hello?name=" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); exit(0 if d.get('message')=='Hello, World!' else 1)"

scenarios.rule: A name longer than 100 characters is rejected
scenarios.scenario: An overly long name is refused

steps.text: an API Consumer calls GET /hello with a name that is 101 characters long
steps.observed: 400 {"error":"name must be at most 100 characters, got 101"}

steps.text: the response is a 400 error and no greeting is returned
steps.command: curl -s -o /tmp/resp.json -w '%{http_code}' "$BASE/hello?name=$LONGNAME" | grep -q '^400$'; python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('/tmp/resp.json')); exit(0 if 'error' in d and 'message' not in d else 1)"
steps.observed: status 400, body {"error":"name must be at most 100 characters, got 101"}, no "message" key present
